from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Split on the all-zero divider, which may be horizontal or vertical.
    if any(all(v == 0 for v in row) for row in grid):
        i = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 0 for v in row))
        panels = [grid[:i], grid[i+1:]]
        out_h, out_w = len(panels[0]), len(panels[0][0])
        bg = [Counter(v for row in p for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0] for p in panels]
        return [[3 if panels[0][r][c] == bg[0] and panels[1][r][c] == bg[1] else 9
                 for c in range(out_w)] for r in range(out_h)]
    j = next(j for j in range(w) if all(grid[r][j] == 0 for r in range(h)))
    panels = [[row[:j] for row in grid], [row[j+1:] for row in grid]]
    bg = [Counter(v for row in p for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0] for p in panels]
    return [[3 if panels[0][r][c] == bg[0] and panels[1][r][c] == bg[1] else 9
             for c in range(len(panels[0][0]))] for r in range(h)]
